upright.short: Intuition, compassion, emotional depth, sensitivity, care.
upright.general: The Queen of Cups symbolizes emotional wisdom, empathy, intuition, and spiritual sensitivity. She represents a caring and understanding person who supports others and deeply understands emotions. The card also points to creativity, healing, and inner harmony.
upright.in_love: A relationship based on tenderness, emotional closeness, trust, and mutual understanding. The card may indicate deep romantic feelings, devotion, and emotional support.
upright.in_situation: The situation requires sensitivity, patience, and intuitive understanding. Success will come through diplomacy, compassion, and emotional awareness.
upright.meaning_for_today: Today is favorable for emotional openness, intuition, compassion, and heartfelt conversations. Trust your feelings and pay attention to subtle emotional signals.
upright.card_advice: Listen to your intuition, show kindness and empathy, and avoid suppressing your emotions. Emotional honesty will help you find harmony.

reversed.general: Reversed, the Queen of Cups may indicate emotional imbalance, hypersensitivity, manipulation through feelings, or unrealistic expectations. A person may become withdrawn, anxious, or emotionally dependent.
reversed.in_love: Misunderstandings, emotional insecurity, jealousy, or manipulation in relationships. One partner may hide true feelings or become overly dependent.
reversed.in_situation: The situation may involve emotional confusion, deception, or inability to see reality clearly. It is important to stay calm and avoid emotional overreaction.
reversed.meaning_for_today: Today may bring emotional sensitivity, insecurity, or confusion that makes it difficult to trust your intuition clearly. Hidden feelings, mood swings, or emotional misunderstandings could influence your interactions with others.
reversed.card_advice: Do not allow emotions to overwhelm your judgment or lead you into unhealthy emotional dependence. Stay grounded, protect your emotional boundaries, and seek clarity before reacting to sensitive situations.
